data.name: Eustace
data.long_meaning: From the Late Latin word eustatius, meaning 'well-established or steadfast'. This name was derived from the Greek word euestatos, which translates to 'good estate' or 'prosperity'. In Christianity, Saint Eustace is known for his unwavering faith and dedication to God.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes steadfastness and unwavering faith in God.

in_hebrew.name: עוסטך
in_hebrew.meaning: בן-אסתר, שם מאוחר לאסתר, משמעות: אותה, שווה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עוסטך הוא שם מאוחר שלאסתר, נקרא כך ביוונית. השם עוסטך בוצע כשם יהודי באירופה בעת העתיקה. בפולניה, עוסטך הוא שם כבוד לאסתר. בשפה העברית, השם 'עוסטך' נכתב 'עוסטך', ופירושו 'שווה, כאחות'.

in_greek.name: Εὐστάθιος
in_greek.meaning: εὐστάθιος, καλός στάθμος, καλός και σταθερός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Ευστάθιος ήταν ένα αρχαίο ελληνικό όνομα, το οποίο κατάγεται από τη λέξη 'εὐστάθιος', που σημαίνει καλός και σταθερός. Γνωστός είναι ο Ευστάθιος ο Αντιοχείας, ο οποίος έζησε τον 3ο αιώνα και ήταν επίσκοπος της Αντιόχειας. Το όνομα Ευστάθιος είναι επίσης γνωστό ως Ευστάθης και Ευστάθιος.

in_latin.name: Eustachius
in_latin.meaning: boni et stabiles significat, nomen originis Graecae
in_latin.long_meaning: Eustachius est nomen Latinum quod a Graecis originibus venit. Significat boni et stabiles. In historia Ecclesiae, Eustachius fuit episcopus Antiochiae saeculo III. Eustachius in usu est in Europae occidentali a saeculo XII.

in_english.name: Eustace
in_english.meaning: well-established, good, stable, of Greek origin
in_english.long_meaning: Eustace is a name of Greek origin, meaning well-established, good, and stable. In Christian tradition, Saint Eustace was a Roman general who converted to Christianity after seeing a vision of Christ between the antlers of a stag. He is revered as a martyr and his feast day is celebrated on September 20. Eustace is also a surname of English origin, derived from the personal name.

saint_reference.note: Saint Eustace was a Roman general who converted to Christianity after seeing a vision of Christ between the antlers of a stag.

data.cultural_impact: Named after Saint Eustace, this name signifies a strong and unyielding character, reminiscent of the saint's steadfastness and unwavering faith. Saint Eustace is also associated with the Texas Longhorn cattle breed, as the name was given to a legendary longhorn bull. As such, the name Eustace can connote strength, resilience, and endurance.
data.spiritual_significance: Eustace is a name deeply rooted in the Christian faith. It signifies a person of good estate and prosperity, reflecting the spiritual blessings bestowed upon us by God. Saint Eustace's unwavering faith despite facing various trials and tribulations serves as an inspiration for us all, reminding us to remain steadfast in our own faith. The name Eustace can be seen as a reminder to stay strong in our spiritual journey and to always trust in the providence of the Almighty.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Eustace is mentioned in the 12th-century book 'De Nominibus Hebraicis' The name Eustace carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Eustace is mentioned in the context of biblical names in the book 'De Nominibus Hebraicis'

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Eustace remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: David Eustace from London, United Kingdom embodies the meaning of Eustace - "Austere or steadfast". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Eustace represents enduring perseverance in the face of adversity. Named after St. Eustace, a Roman soldier who, after having a vision of a crucifix, converted to Christianity and was ultimately martyred for his faith. Thus, Eustace signifies the strength and unwavering commitment to one's beliefs despite the challenges encountered in life.
